faq.title: FAQs
faq.help: Got another question? <contact>Drop me a line</contact>.

cost.q: How much does a website cost?
cost.a: Every project is different, so I don't use fixed price lists. Tell me about your idea and I'll send you a tailored quote.

time.a: A landing page is usually ready in 1–2 weeks once I have your text and photos. Larger sites depend on scope; I'll give you a timeline in the quote.

need.q: What do I need to give you?
need.a: The basics: what you do, who for, and photos of your work. If you don't have text, I'll help you write it.

mine.a: Yes. The domain and the content are yours.

changes.a: Yes: you can ask me, or go for a maintenance plan.

location.q: Do you only work in Madrid?
location.a: I work remotely with businesses all over Spain. If you're nearby, we can also meet in person.

ai.a: Yes, as a tool to work faster. The design, the decisions and the review of every detail are mine (<ai>how I use AI ↓</ai>).

process.title: How I work
process.intro: A clear process, so you always know where your website stands and what comes next.

talk.name: We talk
talk.what: You tell me about your business, your customers and your goals.
talk.get: Focused questions, not an endless form.

quote.name: Fixed quote
quote.what: I define scope, price and timeline.
quote.get: A quote within 24 hours, no small print.

design.name: Design
design.what: I prepare the visual proposal for the pages.
design.get: You see how it will look before any code is written.

build.name: Build
build.what: I build the site and share progress.
build.get: A preview link to review it.

launch.name: Launch
launch.what: We publish it on your domain and check everything works.
launch.get: Your site live, fast and ready for enquiries.

support.name: Support
support.what: Adjustments after delivery, and maintenance if you need it.

ai.title: How I use AI
ai.lead: I work with a method called spec-driven development: before writing a single line of code, I write down what the site must do, how, and to what quality standards. Then I use AI tools such as Claude Code to build faster, and I review, test and fix every part before it goes live.
ai.forYou: Faster delivery without cutting corners on quality.
ai.company: The code for this website is public. You can see the specification, the tasks and the technical decisions in the repository.

spec.name: Specification
spec.text: What the site must do, how, and to what quality standards.

tasks.name: Tasks
tasks.text: The work split into tasks, in order and reviewable.

impl.name: Implementation
impl.text: AI writes each task's code, following the specification.

review.name: Review
review.text: I review, test and fix every part before it goes live.

ai.footer: Decisions and the final review are always mine.

about.title: Hi, I'm Terry
about.lead: I'm Terry Quiñonez, a web developer. I started out teaching myself with YouTube videos: <hl>I was hooked on well-made interfaces, clean and minimal, and I wanted to understand how they were built under the hood.</hl>
about.photoCaption: Illustrated portrait based on a real photo.
about.from: I began my degree in Peru and, with a good part of it done, moved to Spain to finish it: <hl>I now study Software Engineering at the Technical University of Madrid (UPM)</hl>, with part of my previous studies recognised. I live in Quijorna, in the hills west of Madrid.
about.aim: Websites anyone understands at first glance
about.values: Many websites make things hard for people: confusing menus, endless forms, information you can't find. I aim for the opposite. <hl>I treat every project as my own and I don't call it finished until everything works properly.</hl>
about.persistent: I'm persistent: when I set my mind on something, I get it done.
